name: Group of Monuments at Pattadakal
description: Beside the Malaprabha River in northern Karnataka, Pattadakal holds nine Hindu temples and a Jain shrine built under the Chalukya dynasty in the 7th and 8th centuries. Their towers mix northern and southern Indian styles. The star is the Virupaksha Temple, raised around 740 by a queen to celebrate her husband's victory, and still used for worship today.
